options.label: We'll help.
options.tooltip: Leave it to us: whatever has gone wrong, we'll put it right before dusk.

nodes.text: Good morning, Kelderby! Good morning, new faces! Today is the festival: a feast on the square, the bell at dusk, the lighthouse lamp over the bay and the castle's fireworks at midnight. Nothing can possibly go wrong.

That? That is everything going wrong at once. The boatwright's cargo boat has turned over in the bay with the feast in it. The cooper's goats are up the terraces. The bell rope has snapped. And the lighthouse lamp went out in the night, and the keeper is up there swearing at it. Pick one. Pick all of them. Be back on this stage by dusk.
How is it going? Don't tell me. Tell me at dusk. Smile at the town.
Hold the street! Nobody touches the cake!
Look at them. Look at all of them. Right. Whatever happened today, that is the festival now. Shall I begin?

options.label: We're going up.
options.tooltip: Climb the tower and light the lamp.

nodes.text: Went out at three this morning. Wick's fine, oil's fine, the lamp is sulking. Also the stairs gave way in three places on the way up, so you'll be jumping. Light it before the oil goes cold and I'll owe you.
A fox. In MY storeroom. With MY key. And now it is off up the road with it, and the fireworks are locked in until somebody catches it.
The cake is done. Four tiers, candied cherries, a sugar lighthouse on top. It goes on the stage at dusk and nobody breathes on it until midnight.
My dear, I have watched sixty-one of these festivals and every one of them nearly did not happen. Go on. I shall be in the front row tonight.

options.label: We'll row out.
options.tooltip: Take Sverre's boat out into the bay and bring the crates in.

nodes.text: Turned her over on the bar, didn't I. Six crates of the feast washed up on the shoals, and two of them out past the sandbar; go round by the channel at the harbour end of the bar. Take the Herring, the boat by the steps; she rows true. They won't sit on those shoals long once the tide's on them.
Mind the bar. The boats don't, which is how we got here.

options.label: We'll bring them home.
options.tooltip: Fetch wheat from the field and lead the three goats back into the pen.

nodes.text: My three goats are out of the pen. Pearl, the little white nanny, is up the castle road. Barley, the brown one, is at the wayside spring. And the Admiral, the goat with the beard, who undid the latch, is in the orchard. They'll follow wheat anywhere. The field's out on the farm track.
If you see a goat anywhere it shouldn't be, it's one of mine.

options.label: Give me the bow.
options.tooltip: Take Vidar's bow and arrows and shoot the target in the bell tower.

nodes.text: By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. The rope snapped this morning, and the knot is caught on the archery target up in the tower's opening, where nobody can reach it. I have a bow. I have never once hit anything with it. Three clean hits would shake the knot free.

happening.subject: npc/runa
happening.text: Runa believes her sister's cow is calving and runs off to it.

options.label: Your sister's cow is calving!
options.tooltip: Send Runa off up the farm track to her sister's calving cow, and take the mare while she is gone.

nodes.text: Moss is in the back stable. She can be hired, at the barrel there, for pennies, which the town is handing out today to anyone who mends something. She is not for running down the main street with.
